remarks: Welcome to 29 Ridgeley Street, a charming Cape Cod-style home tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in the heart of Darien. This beautifully maintained rental features four generously sized bedrooms, a full basement, and updated kitchen and bathrooms for modern comfort and style. Enjoy cooking in the renovated kitchen with sleek finishes and plenty of counter space, then unwind in the spacious backyard-perfect for entertaining or relaxing outdoors. Inside, bright and inviting living spaces offer flexibility for families, guests, or a home office. Located just a short stroll from the Darien train station, shopping, and the vibrant restaurants of Darien Commons, this home offers the perfect blend of privacy and convenience. With Darien's newest amenities right at your fingertips, this is a rare rental opportunity not to be missed!
